content:
Anika Rao: Heads-up — organizational update for next week: Samir Patel will step in as interim Head of Private Deployments and Dedicated Capacity (6-month rotation) starting Mon Apr 6. This is a temporary assignment while we run a search for the permanent lead. :megaphone:

Samir Patel: Thank you! Excited to take this on. My immediate goals: stabilize current on-prem rollouts, review SLA playbooks, and keep Dedicated capacity roadmap on-track. Will set up 1:1s with PMs and the infra leads this week.

Grace Huang: congrats @Samir! quick Q — who covers Samir's current scope (capacity pricing + partner onboarding) day-to-day?

Anika Rao: Grace — Grace Huang will backfill some of Samir's PM day-to-day responsibilities for the next 6 months (capacity pricing, partner onboarding). We'll confirm direct reports in the org chart doc later today.

Evan Carter: Appreciate the heads-up. Two asks: 1) please share escalation path for Dedicated incidents while Samir is covering PD; 2) a note for sales/customer success so they're not surprised.

Samir Patel: Good calls. I'll be primary escalation for product decisions, and Evan you can route urgent infra incidents to Tomas (cc'd) for SRE coordination. I'll draft a customer-facing note and loop in CS tomorrow.

Mariam Okoye: Congrats Samir and Grace! Any impact on hiring timelines for the Dedicated Capacity PM role?

Anika Rao: Hiring will continue — we expect the external search to run in parallel. The rotation is explicitly to keep momentum while we evaluate candidates. No hiring freeze.

Tomas Alvarez: FYI from SRE perspective: please add me to any PD on-call rotation updates. We'll scope any on-call load rebalancing this week.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: org chart update requested. Link: https://redwood-internal/people-ops/org-charts/2027-q2 (edit access: people-ops, eng-leads).

Grace Huang: I'll take the handover doc for partner onboarding. Samir — can you drop a short runbook in the doc with current vendor touchpoints?

Samir Patel: Adding runbook now. Will summarize active private deployments and current open capacity commitments.

Anika Rao: Next steps from People Ops: 1) Town hall thread scheduled Fri 9am to explain rotation and hiring plan; 2) org chart and role matrix updated today; 3) recruiting kickoff for permanent hire (requisition posted). I'll post the town hall calendar invite and a short FAQ in #announcements.

Evan Carter: Thanks — please include a section in the FAQ about customer SLAs and support handoffs so support can triage appropriately.

Mariam Okoye: Adding: kudos to Grace for stepping up on short notice. :clap:

Grace Huang: Thanks team — I'll take notes during 1:1s and share a concise status doc by EOD Friday.

Anika Rao: Closing note: this is a temporary rotation to keep product continuity. Reach out to me or @people-ops if you have concerns.

Samir Patel: Thanks everyone. Ping me directly for anything PD-related or if you need me to join customer calls this week.

people-ops-bot: Action items created: 1) org chart update; 2) town hall invite; 3) recruiting kickoff. Assignees: Anika, Grace, Samir.
